name: Notion

verdict.topBlocker: Installation scope (Any workspace vs Selected workspaces only) is fixed at creation, so picking the wrong one means recreating the connection and re-issuing credentials.
verdict.summary: A public connection with Any workspace scope works over OAuth for any Notion user immediately with no required review. Marketplace listing (5-10 business days, security review) is optional; after install, the agent only sees pages each user shares, Enterprise admins can block or allowlist connections, and rate limits are about 3 requests/second.

steps.title: Create a public connection with 'Any workspace' scope
steps.detail: In https://app.notion.com/developers/connections create a public connection; set name, development workspace, redirect URI(s), capabilities and installation scope. Choose 'Any workspace' for a multi-customer product: scope cannot be changed later.

steps.title: Configure redirect URIs and capabilities
steps.detail: Add redirect URI(s) and choose capabilities (read/update/insert content, user info). Notion has no OAuth scopes beyond these capabilities. Copy client ID/secret from the Configuration tab.

steps.title: (Optional) Draft privacy policy and terms of service
steps.detail: Prepare standard legal compliance documents required for public application distribution.

steps.title: Implement OAuth authorization request and page picker
steps.detail: Send users to https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&redirect_uri=...&response_type=code&owner=user&state=...; users pick pages to share.

steps.title: Exchange code for tokens and handle refresh
steps.detail: POST https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token with Basic auth base64(client_id:client_secret), grant_type=authorization_code, code, redirect_uri. Store access_token and refresh_token; refresh with grant_type=refresh_token and save the new refresh token.

steps.title: (Optional) Submit public connection for security review and marketplace listing
steps.detail: Manage marketplace listing details via the Listings section and submit the public connection for Notion security review.

steps.title: (Optional) Await Notion marketplace and security review
steps.detail: Wait for Notion's team to complete the security review and approve the public application for the Marketplace.

requirements.note: A Notion developer account is required to access the Developer portal and create connections.
Required when publishing your application publicly or listing on the Notion Marketplace.
Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being listed on the Marketplace.

scopes.note: All public connections follow the OAuth 2.0 protocol and require security review before marketplace publication.

blockers.symptom: Authorization URL field is missing or unpopulated in the connection settings.
blockers.cause: The Authorization URL field populates only after a public connection is submitted for review.
blockers.unblock: Submit the public connection for review in the Developer portal to generate the authorization URL.

blockers.symptom: Redirect URI mismatch errors during OAuth callback.
blockers.cause: The redirect URI used in the authorization request does not exactly match the URI configured during connection creation.
blockers.unblock: Ensure the redirect URI specified in code matches the configuration in your Developer portal settings exactly.

blockers.symptom: User cancels auth flow and application crashes or hangs.
blockers.cause: The application does not handle the OAuth error query parameter when a user presses Cancel.
blockers.unblock: Build your connection to handle the error query parameter (e.g. error=access_denied) gracefully when redirected.
